pages.text: $(bold)Dragonsteel Lightning$() (Default trait of Dragonsteel Lightning)$(br2)Effect: $(bold)On hit$(), summons a thunderbolt, dealing damage and $(bold)disarming$() the target for 3 seconds.$(br2)The thunderbolt deals considerable damage, and the disarm prevents the target from attacking with weapons for 3 seconds, providing both burst and crowd control.
